DANIEL BORJA Sangguniang Barangay Member Barangay 3, Calamba City, Laguna borjadanielvincent@yahoo.com Dear Sangguniang Barangay Member Borja: This has reference to your electronic mail dated March 8, 2024, requesting this Department's opinion concerning certain acts of Punong Barangay (PB), Donnie P. Alvarez, towards you. Per your email, hereunder are the relevant factual antecedents: On December 29, 2023, the Barangay Secretary called you to rewrite the typewritten Accomplishment Report as ordered by PB Alvarez. You indicated that you have difficulty with handwriting; hence, all your previous reports were all typewritten. Ostensibly, the Barangay Secretary insisted that you write your Accomplishment Reports in handwriting; otherwise, PB Alvarez will not accept such reports. On January 8, 2024, in the Sanggunian regular session, PB Alvarez made a manifestation forbidding you to do and submit a typewritten accomplishment report. On January 28, 2024, you discussed, though you're the sangguniang Facebook group chat, with the sangguniang barangay members that you demand changes in regular sessions to eliminate the chitchat and focus on the issues and concerns. The discussion, however, was met with provoking and insulting replies from PB Alvarez. On February 5, 2024, the sanggunian held a session where PB Alvarez made indecent remarks. On March 4, 2024, the sanggunian held its regular session, of which you were not made aware. Premised from the foregoing, arose your request for legal opinion on the following issues, which we herein quoted in verbatim, to wit: I. Can the Punong Barangay exclude me from barangay activities like regular sessions, special sessions, and other activities? 2. Can the Punong Barangay just ignore me since I am an opposition and not a member of his political party? And 3. Can the Punong Barangay refuse the funding of my project in the committee in (sic) agriculture like the Hapag project? "Matino, Mahusay at Maasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54

Notably, the foregoing issues are fundamentally interrelated, and hence, we shall address the same in one discussion. Foremost, it is to be emphasized that the sangguiang barangay is deemed a collegial body; each and every member—regardless of their political party affiliations—has equal rights, and hence they all should be afforded equal rights in carrying out their duties to serve their constituents. While it is true that the Punong Barangay is the presiding officer of the sanggunian, the Local Government Code of 1991 (hereinafter referred to as the Code) does not clothe the Punong Barangay with the power to exclude or marginalize any sanggunian member from regular sessions and from any of its other official functions. In the same vein, the Punong Barangay is without authority to refuse the funding of a project by any sangguniang barangay member based on political reasons; the same should be made based on legitimate or legal grounds recognized under the Code and other pertinent laws, such as budgetary constraints. Accordingly, excluding or marginalizing a sangguniang member from any of its functions or activities sans legal justification could be tantamount to abuse of authority and oppression, which are among the grounds for disciplinary actions pursuant to the Codel. Hence, it behooves the Punong Barangay, as the Presiding Officer, to treat all sangguniang barangay members equally and justly—irrespective of political differences. Notwithstanding, it is to be emphasized, however, that this Department is an agency under the executive branch of the government, and as such, it is devoid of authority to declare invalid or illegal any legislative measures enacted or passed by local government officials, nor does it have authority to declare invalid or illegal any acts committed by local government officials that are alleged to be in violation of the Local Government Code or any other applicable laws. The same must be threshed out in the proper forum. This opinion is being rendered without prejudice to any contrary opinion of competent authorities or the courts. We hope to have guided you accordingly. Thank you Very truly yours, By e Authority of the Secre AN ICTOR R.
